§ 01 · The Program

Real clauses,
real decisions.

From drafting a business contract and handling a lawsuit, to ensuring regulatory compliance, protecting intellectual property, and aligning legal strategy with business goals, every scenario drops you into a genuine legal or compliance situation and asks one question: what should you actually do? Thirty-nine foundations-focused scenarios and sixty-one strategy-and-risk-focused scenarios, covered systematically, one real decision at a time.

01

Built for real legal judgment

Every scenario mirrors an actual situation a legal or compliance professional faces — never abstract, never artificial.

02

Systematic, complete coverage

A full set of 100 scenarios across contracts, compliance, intellectual property, investigations, and corporate governance.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with clear, encouraging feedback after every exercise.

04

Genuine decision-making practice

Real situations with one best-practice response and three realistic missteps — not vocabulary drills, but sound legal judgment under real regulatory pressure.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English & Legal Coach

Brice Gadou is a business English specialist dedicated to helping legal and compliance professionals think clearly under pressure in a second language. Mr. Gad reflects his belief that real fluency in law isn't reciting phrases — it's reading a situation correctly and choosing the right response, in the moment.

Designed for B1–C1 learners who already work in, or aspire to work in, legal and compliance roles in English — Mr. Gad Legal & Compliance is more than a language course. It's a working rehearsal for the legal moments you'll actually face.
